title: Your & My Secret
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Nanako Momoi, a pretty but rude and violent tomboy, and Akira Uehara, a shy, gentle boy secretly in love with her, swap bodies through her inventor grandfather's machine. Akira is desperate to change back, but Nanako starts to enjoy life as a boy. The comedy plays on gender expectations and a love polygon at school.
life_message: A good life means accepting who you are inside, even when it does not match what others expect of your body.
